Due to failed Washington Democrat policies, small businesses are struggling to provide health insurance for their employees & providers can’t keep up with rising input costs.

@WaysandMeansGOP will continue working on policies to help patients receive the health care they deserve https://t.co/ceC3fQzj4d

It was an honor to cut the ribbon of the new trail at the Grand Patrician Resort in Milton, WV.

Health & wellness are so important & this is a great step towards improving the lives of so many! I look forward to all of the future announcements to come at the Grand Patrician. https://t.co/VzhziPpMb5

I met with WV Insurance Commissioner Allan McVey to discuss insurance related issues impacting consumers in our state.

I will continue working with our state’s insurance regulators as they provide and establish the best insurance practices and options for my constituents. https://t.co/MK28XiYfZe

No matter how far West Virginians live from the nearest hospital, they deserve the highest quality of healthcare.

The Telehealth Expansion Act makes it easier for everyone to have access to healthcare.

Watch more from @WaysandMeansGOP ⬇️ https://t.co/OBcMhwWIMV

During a @WaysandMeansGOP field hearing in #WV, we heard from a struggling small business owner who had to decide between paying for her employees' health insurance or keeping the lights on.

Bad policies coming out of Washington have devastating results on hardworking Americans. https://t.co/u1hNuVPYpZ

Since 2014, @LilysPlaceWV has helped ease withdrawal symptoms and take care of infants that have been exposed to drug substances during the prenatal stage.

Thank you for having me and for your hard work in protecting the wellbeing of our children! https://t.co/jDZrEBN7P4

I’ve said it once and I’ll say it again: our health care system is the only one where patients don’t know how much they’ll pay before receiving treatment.

We owe it to patients to change that.

Watch more ⬇️ https://t.co/kNa1HG3916

I joined @RepTerriSewell in introducing a bill that will provide chronic kidney disease patients the resources and access to treatment they need to fight this ‘silent killer’.

Read more ⬇️

https://t.co/xmP3wGBi3X

Kidney patients should have access to as many cost effective therapies as possible.

I introduced the Kidney PATIENT Act with @RepBuddyCarter, @RepAnnieKuster, & @RepTerriSewell to provide affordable treatment for patients.

Read more ⬇️
https://t.co/NDIPUb8grT

I joined @RepNewhouse in condemning @GovMLG for depriving the people of New Mexico of their constitutional right to bear arms.

For 30 days, citizens will be fined up to $5k if they want to exercise the Second Amendment. This is unacceptable & I’ll always stand for our freedoms.

My colleagues & I sent a letter to @CMSGov to expand home dialysis for acute kidney injury patients.

During the process of dialysis, it’s crucial kidney disease patients have the option to control & monitor their wellbeing from the comfort of their home.
https://t.co/QVUtxyIT7S

Since 1989, Agent Pipeline has helped West Virginians better understand their insurance options and seek out the most affordable, competitive plans. 

It was great to meet with them this morning to see firsthand the work they are doing. https://t.co/qNzs8CFq1w

ESRD patients, especially those in rural areas, should have access to home dialysis treatments to make their lives as easy as possible. 

I spoke with an ESRD patient at a @WaysandMeansGOP hearing on how home dialysis can make a positive difference in their treatment. https://t.co/QBGuXlUFGx

Patients must be the number one priority of the investigation into the alarming cyberattack on Change Healthcare. 

I sent a letter with @vernbuchanan voicing concerns about the dangers of stolen private health data. We urge HHS to work with us to ensure patients are protected. https://t.co/qx70ohBdSo

My staff will be hosting mobile office hours in Ripley on Monday, April 29. Please feel free to join if you need any help with veterans & Social Security benefits, Medicare difficulties, immigration issues, military records or medals, or assistance with federal agencies. https://t.co/MFTo74OVQc

A provision within my bill, the Assistance for Rural Community Hospitals (ARCH) Act, just passed @WaysandMeansGOP! 

This provision will extend Medicare-dependent and Medicare-low volume payments to rural hospitals through FY 2025.

Watch below ⬇️ https://t.co/Pu3iRZtYs1

I am so glad I had the chance to meet sweet Ziler and her family on Children’s Hospital Association Family Advocacy Day.

@WVUKids does an amazing job at providing care and treatment for their young patients. Thank you for all of your hard work! https://t.co/9E6W5DE97T

I enjoyed speaking with the CEO and Chief External Affairs Officer of @BooneMemorialWV about their plans to increase wellness in #WV.

I’m grateful for the work the hospital staff provides for their patients and West Virginia as a whole & excited to see their plans come to life! https://t.co/PDOfDmkFew

Today, I toured the Logan Regional Medical Center to see their acute care facility and meet with some of their staff.

I am thankful for the quality treatment and health care services that they provide their patients, and for their generosity in serving their community. https://t.co/ECQbSW9O8z

Thank you @HRSAgov for recognizing West Virginia’s commitment to providing quality health care services!

Our CAHs placed 4th nationwide in the Medicare Beneficiary Quality Improvement Project & I am thankful for all they do to support patients across #WV. https://t.co/KiRQAOQhu4

I met with staff from the Beckley Appalachian Regional Hospital to discuss their plans for the hospital as well as healthcare in the state. I look forward to working together to ensure that the health of my constituents are being prioritized and hope to visit again soon. https://t.co/TzyVHSbrij

ICYMI: Having access to resources like food assistance programs and proper guidance can help individuals live healthier lifestyles.

In a @WaysandMeansGOP hearing, I asked @drmarkhyman about what role food and nutrition play in managing chronic diseases. https://t.co/sRqiRRqe94
